isRegisteredMarket(address,uint8).details: Uses explicit registry membership; avoids trusting user-supplied market labels.

createAdapter(address,address,uint8).notice: Anyone can create a unique adapter, but cannot enable it or move vault funds.

deallocate(bytes,uint256,bytes4,address).details: ERC4626 withdraw() requests exact assets. Legacy Beefy withdraw()      burns shares and can return too little due to strategy losses/fees;      the full parent Vault V2 operation reverts in that case.

idData(address).details: UI passes idData(market) to increaseAbsoluteCap and increaseRelativeCap.

realAssets().details: Counts all active positions, each in parent vault asset denomination.

registerPosition(address,uint8).details: A registry-registered omniadapter does not automatically trust      arbitrary ERC4626/Beefy implementations. Curator owns this choice.

idData(address).notice: Exact cap identifier used by parent Vault V2.

positionAssets(address).notice: Only supported market variants can be registered. Some ERC4626         targets may restrict deposits or impose withdrawal delays/fees.

registerPosition(address,uint8).notice: Curator must explicitly register every underlying vault.

setEnabledModes(uint8).notice: Owner can disable deposit modes at any time. Existing positions         can still deallocate while their mode is disabled.

createAdapter(address,uint8).notice: Creates one adapter per vault with selectable execution modes.         Does not authorize it, configure market caps or move assets.
